Known category IDs: NEW 0, default 1, cartoon 3, emoji 4, everyday 5, nature 6, symbol 7, pattern 8, creative 9, photo 12, category 15, business 16, holiday 17, recommend 18, AI 40. Labels can vary by language. Other specialized or moderated IDs do not imply anonymous access.
Email and Password identify the account. The recovered request also supplies TimeZone, CountryISOCode and Language; omission requirements have not been tested.
Password is a lowercase 32-character MD5 digest. For non-ASCII passwords, the recovered hashing behavior uses the low byte of each UTF-16 code unit, which can differ from hashing UTF-8 bytes.
The response includes numeric Token and UserId, profile fields and flags. ReturnCode=11 indicates token mismatch and requires a fresh session.

endpoints.response_evidence: Live generation and result retrieval verified on 14 October 2026; DeviceId not observed. See endpoint documentation for probes and limitations.
notes: Successful authenticated request included numeric Token and UserId, the valid AiEncryption signature, Text, JetBraking=0, Size=128, Weight=100, Seed=100 and Fast=0. Command was omitted. Session-field omission and anonymous access were not tested.

ReturnCode=0 with data.promptId means job submission, not completed generation. Poll GET /ai/comfyui/history/{promptId}/{userId}, then download GET /ai/comfyui/image/view with filename and subfolder query parameters.

Initial polling returned ReturnCode=1 and status=sending with null filename/progress/subfolder; a subsequent poll about five seconds later returned status=success, progress=100 and a WebP filename. This transient task-details error was not terminal.
AiEncryption=null and plain MD5 of UserId both returned HTTP 200, ReturnCode=1 and data=null. The server calls the signature MD5, but the recovered app uses HMAC-MD5, confirmed by a successful probe.
Size=16 was accepted for submission but remained sending with task-details errors during observed polling. Polling stopped at user request; native 16x16 support is inconclusive.
No animation-generation endpoint or frame-count/duration parameter was found in the recovered AI workflow. The verified output was a still image.

parameters.name: FileId
parameters.requirement: Required to identify the requested file; omission behavior untested.
parameters.description: Artwork path supplied by a gallery response.

notes: No request body is used. The response contains proprietary artwork bytes, not necessarily GIF data. See the artwork format reference for decoding.
An already absolute artwork URL can be requested directly instead of prefixing the regional file host.
